launches.title: Akon Labs: We're building the most token-efficient coding agent in the world
launches.tagline: GitNexus gives coding agents a map of your codebase, so they stop burning tokens looking for it.
launches.body:
##### We're building the most token-efficient coding agent in the world. The reason it works is GitNexus, our open-source knowledge graph for your codebase.

<https://youtu.be/-ErU4cCRSlQ>

##### The problem

Coding agents don't understand your repo. They grep, they guess, they re-read the same files, and they stuff half your codebase into a context window hoping the answer is in there somewhere. You pay for every one of those tokens, and the agent still misses the cross-file relationship that mattered.

The bottleneck isn't the model. It's context.

##### What we built:

GitNexus indexes your repository into a knowledge graph (symbols, call paths, imports, ownership, history) and serves the agent exactly the context a task needs, instead of everything it might need.

It's one connected stack:

* The knowledge graph. Run npx gitnexus analyze and you have it
* A coding agent that runs on top of it
* Automated PR review grounded in the same graph

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=110659&key=user_uploads/1607382/1d3e51af-d3b5-4ee6-b0c3-b80bc4337c3e)

##### The proof:

On the DeepSWE benchmark, we ran the same agent with our graph and without it:

* 37% to 68.4% pass rate. Nearly twice the bugs solved
* Half the cost per fix, with fewer tokens
* On the hardest tasks, the gap more than triples

Full methodology and results: <https://www.akonlabs.com/benchmarks>

##### Where we are:

* 45,000+ GitHub stars
* 65,000 weekly npm downloads
* 10+ enterprises onboarded

##### About the team:

Subham Kundu and Abhigyan Patwari have spent nearly half a decade working on knowledge graphs. Between them, they've been founding engineers, CTOs, and principal AI engineers, taking products from 0 to 100 at multiple startups. Subham is a seasoned engineer who has scaled products to millions of users, won multiple hackathons, and doing a PhD in reinforcement learning. Abhigyan is a seasoned technologist and serial open source contributor, with involvement across multiple open source projects.

##### Run it in your way:

Managed, or fully sovereign. Self-hosted, air-gapped, nothing leaves your network.

##### Looking to cut your coding agent bill?

If you want to lower your coding agent spend without giving up frontier performance, sign up at <https://www.akonlabs.com>. We'll get you set up on your own repo and show you the before-and-after on your actual token costs.

##### Our other asks

* Try the open-source version. Run npx gitnexus analyze. Takes a minute
* Intros. Engineering leaders where agent cost or code-context quality is a real line item, especially in regulated or air-gapped environments
* Tell us where it breaks. Weird monorepos and polyglot repos are the most useful feedback we get

GitNexus, by Akon Labs. The nervous system for agent context.
